paragraphs: The COPS Training Portal provides no-cost training materials to law enforcement organizations, training academies and individual officers, supporting training already conducted at the local level. It is powered by the National Center for Policing Innovation.

The curriculum is self-paced and easy to start, stop and resume around the demands of a day. The portal serves as a gateway to a variety of multimedia community policing resources. Listed material includes a course on vehicular pursuit management and the balance of risk and safety. Another covers elder justice tools and strategies for law enforcement. There is a mobile app for the portal as well.

The project is supported by cooperative agreements awarded by the Office of Community Oriented Policing Services at the U.S. Department of Justice. The site notes that opinions in the material are those of the authors and do not necessarily represent official Department of Justice positions or policies. The COPS Office released a video resource called Introduction to Blue Alert. That covers the National Blue Alert Network, a nationwide emergency notification program that informs the public when a law enforcement officer is killed, seriously injured, threatened or missing in the line of duty.
